author: KEXP
description: The Southern California six-piece Dutch Interior ebb and flow through dusty-alt country, indie-rock, folk, and more in our latest in-studio session. With host Greg Vandy, the band share a compelling performance of "Fourth Street" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Dutch Interior performs "Fourth Street" & more Live on KEXP
